delta_note: XEMA Socrata nzvn-apee variable 35 (PPT, semi-hourly, data_lectura in UTC, labelled at the start of the bin). Ph is the sum of half-hours whose UTC stamp falls in that Europe/Madrid clock hour. Not a day-cumulative delta. Hours before the archive starts are absent — never fabricated. When the official XEMA daily (1300) exists for a station-day, the explorador uses that daily total instead of this provisional sum (no double count). v1 slim: Ph==0 omitted from series (missing key ≡ 0 mm).
